roles.name: Reporting_Read
roles.description: See and download Reporting-Service reports (catalog requiredRole). Grants no M3 endpoints. grp-fin-manager is interim until it is nested into rpt-reader (ADR-013), then remove it.

roles.name: Reporting_General
roles.description: Non-sensitive reference reports, e.g. Inventory List. Application Role rpt-reader; rpt-admin for reporting support. grp-fin-manager is interim (keeps Finance's current access) until Business Function groups are nested into rpt-reader (ADR-061), then remove it. Grants no M3 endpoints.

roles.name: Reporting_Finance_Management
roles.description: Finance management reports with money values, e.g. Inventory Valuation. Application Role rpt-finance-mgmt; rpt-admin for reporting support. grp-fin-manager is interim until it is nested into rpt-finance-mgmt (ADR-061), then remove it. Grants no M3 endpoints.

roles.name: Reporting_SupplyChain
roles.description: Supply Chain operational reports (stage 3 onward). Application Role rpt-supplychain with grp-sc-buyer and grp-sc-manager nested in AD; rpt-admin for reporting support. Grants no M3 endpoints. Knowledge vault ADR-061.

roles.name: Reporting_SupplyChain_Management
roles.description: Supply Chain management reports (buyer performance), e.g. POs Issued by Buyer. Application Role rpt-supplychain-mgmt with grp-sc-manager nested in AD; rpt-admin for reporting support. Grants no M3 endpoints. Knowledge vault ADR-061.
